# <span id="aanchor327"></span> Data Archive Per Device Configuration

Accessing this form requires **Data Archive** Crypkey license and **Application Process – Data Archive** privileges.

Use the Data Archive Per Device Configuration screen to enable or disable archive operations for meters and locations (individually or through lists/close groups), add notes, and view archival and restore history per object, list of objects, or measurement month.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Data Archive Per Device Configuration screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Data Archive Per Device Configuration** within the **Application** group.

This screen is accessible from the production database only; it is not accessible from the archival database.

</div>

## Screen Tabs

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Setup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Setup</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Setup">

Use the Setup tab to enable archival functionality and add notes for individual meters and locations.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 606;height: 385;" />

The following items are available on the Setup tab:

- **Enable archival for this device** - Select this option to enable archive/restore/purge operations for the selected object. By default, these operations are disabled for newly created meters and locations.

- **Comments** - Add an optional comment for the selected object (up to 2,000 characters allowed).

- **Apply to device’s children** - Select this option to apply the same settings to the immediate children of the selected object.

  - This option is always disabled for meters and always enabled for lists and close groups.
  - If this option is enabled for a location, the settings will be applied to the immediate child meters and locations of the parent location.

  You can use a list or close group to bulk enable/disable archive operations and add comments; however, the checkbox will display as unchecked and the comment field will be empty when these object types are selected. The changes will be saved on individual meters and locations.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="History">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />History</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="History">

The History tab displays archive, restore, and purge histories for the selected objects; it also allows manual restore, manual re-archive, and manual purge operations for selected records.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 611;height: 388;" />

The following items are available on the History tab:

- **Item Number** - Meter or location number.
- **Item Type** - Meter or location object type.
- **Contract Month** - ID for the contract month of the selected object.
- **Status** - Current status of the selected object and contract month.
- **Time of Archive** - Time stamp of manual re-archive, if applicable.
- **Time of Restore** - Time stamp of manual restore, if applicable.
- **Time of Purge** - Time stamp of manual purge, if applicable.
- **Archive Username** - User who initiated the manual re-archive process, if applicable.
- **Restore Username** - User who initiated the manual restore process, if applicable.
- **Error Message** - Any error message generated by the data archive service when processing the records.

<!-- -->

- **Restore** - Queue the selected records for restore, which moves archived data back to production database from archive database. This option is only available for records with status of "Archived", "Restore Failure", or "Purge Failure".

  Once an archived record is restored, the archive service will not queue the record to be archived again in the future; these items will need to be manually queued be re-archived.

- **Re-Archive** - Queue the selected records for manual re-archive, which moves previous restored data from production database to archive database. This option is only available for records with status of "Archival Failure" or "Restore".

- **Manual Purge** - Queue the selected records for purge, which deletes archived data from archive database permanently. This optional is only available for records with status of "Archived", "Restore Failure", or "Purge Failure".

  **IMPORTANT:** This operation is ****not reversible**;** once purged, the data cannot be recovered.

</div>
